_comment: Regression baseline for the agent-eval CI gate (issue #99). 'passing' lists fixture::agent (and fixture::skill) pairs known to pass a live /agent-eval run. The live gate fails only when a pair listed here REGRESSES (was passing, now fails), so an empty list never red-lines the gate. Record a baseline by running a green live eval and adding its passing pairs here. See evals/README.md.
